title: Fall Raku Firing
bring: No materials required; participants select and glaze a premade pot
commitment: 10am-3pm, hourly firings; schedule your glazing and firing time
how_to_join: Register online to reserve a pot and time slot
summary: On October 10, 2026, watch your glazed pot fire in a wood-fired raku kiln with immediate reduction and thermal shock creating signature crackled surfaces. Reserve your pot and time slot in advance; firing time is roughly 30 minutes to an hour.
source_quote: Join us on Saturday, October 10th between 10am and 3pm for a wood-fired raku firing.
evidence_sentence: The event description states participants choose and glaze a pot then watch it get fired in View's wood-fired raku kiln.
evidence_quote: Purchase a pot, glaze it in one of View's raku glazes and watch it get fired in real time.
